xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5522: Add GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to the model catalog

plan.title: Add GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to the model catalog
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. Overdeck could not pick, route or price them.
narratives.Proposal: Retroactive plan for work already in PR #5530, built by a supervised handoff. Mirror PAN-4633 and PAN-4634: add both ids at every site that lists GPT-6.x models, pin both to the 272K billing tier, price them from the 2026-11-18 pricing page, set the Codex floor to 0.170.0, add them to the CLIProxy 272K pin set after a live probe, and document them.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to any default model, role routing or the openai-to-codex harness routing
- No [372k] long-context variant for either model
- No gpt-reserve entry (no published price)
- No modeling of the >272K long-context price tier in cost rows
- No maxOutputTokens for either model (not published)

items.title: Register gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol in the capability, class, fallback, provider and settings tables

narrative.Action: Add capability entries for both models (contextWindow CLIPROXY_GPT56_CONTEXT_WINDOW, efforts low through max, astra inherits gpt-6-astra skills, sol inherits gpt-6.1-sol skills, costPer1MTokens 24 and 6), class frontier, fallback to claude-sonnet-5-5, tier rank 3 and 2, the openai provider and settings lists, the settings catalog order with 6.2 first, and MODEL_API_IDS.

items.title: Given MODEL_CAPABILITIES, when gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol are read, then each has the openai provider, contextWindow 272000, effort levels low/medium/high/xhigh/max and capability class frontier, as model-capabilities.test.ts asserts.
Given the settings model catalog API, when it lists OpenAI models, then gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol are the first two entries, as settings-model-catalog.test.ts asserts.
Price gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol from the 2026-11-18 OpenAI pricing page

narrative.Action: Add DEFAULT_PRICING rows: gpt-6.2-astra $0.008/$0.0004/$0.040 per 1K input/cached/output and gpt-6.2-sol $0.002/$0.0001/$0.010, citing developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-11-18).

items.title: Given getPricing, when called for openai gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol, then it returns the row for that exact model with the published input, cached and output prices, as cost.test.ts asserts.
Given src/lib/cost.ts, when read, then the 6.2 rows cite developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-11-18) and state that the price tier above 272K is not modeled.
Set the Codex ChatGPT sign-in floor for both models to 0.170.0

narrative.Action: Add gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol to CODEX_MODEL_MINIMUM_VERSIONS at 0.170.0, the version verified to list both.

items.title: Given a ChatGPT sign-in and Codex CLI 0.169.0, when canUseHarness checks either 6.2 model on the codex harness, then it refuses and names 0.170.0; at 0.170.0 or with api-key auth it allows the launch, as harness-policy.test.ts asserts.
Given pan doctor, when checkCodexModelFloors runs, then it returns six floor rows including both 6.2 models, as doctor-codex-models.test.ts asserts.
Pin both models to 272K on the claude-code CLIProxy route

narrative.Action: Add both models to GPT_56_MODELS and record the 2026-11-18 probe: CLIProxy v8.0.71 listed both in GET /v1/models and returned a completion for each through POST /v1/messages.

items.title: Given getClaudeCodeContextPolicyForModel, when called for gpt-6.2-astra or gpt-6.2-sol, then it exports the same 272K window as the capability table, as the model-capabilities.test.ts harness-env case asserts.
Given src/lib/cliproxy.ts, when read, then a comment records the 2026-11-18 probe of v8.0.71 (both models listed and served), and CLIPROXY_RELEASE_VERSION stays v8.0.71.
Show both models in the Settings catalog, model picker and friendly names

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/dashboard-utils.test.ts

narrative.Action: Add both models at the top of the frontend MODELS_BY_PROVIDER openai list and the ModelPicker fallback group, and map them in getFriendlyModelName.

items.title: Given getFriendlyModelName, when called with gpt-6.2-astra or gpt-6.2-sol, then it returns GPT-6.2 Astra or GPT-6.2 Sol, as dashboard-utils.test.ts asserts.
Given the frontend MODELS_BY_PROVIDER openai list and the ModelPicker OpenAI fallback group, when read, then both list gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol first, with costPer1MTokens 24 and 6.
Document both models and add the changelog entry

narrative.Action: Document prices, the 272K pin, the 0.170.0 Codex floor and the CLIProxy probe in configuration/harnesses.mdx and docs/MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md, and add changelog.d/pan-5522.md under New.

items.title: Given configuration/harnesses.mdx, when read, then it names gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol with their prices, the 0.170.0 Codex floor and the 2026-11-18 CLIProxy probe.
Given changelog.d/pan-5522.md, when npm run lint:docs runs, then it passes with one New bullet for the two models.

metadata.sizeJustification: Adding a model id is one inseparable change: the same id must land in every catalog, routing, pricing, floor, frontend and docs list at once, or the model is half-registered (pickable but unpriced, or priced but unroutable). The diff is about 150 lines spread thinly across those lists, mirroring PAN-4633 (29 files).
